sample_unit: clinical vignettes (rare disease cases) per language

links.outcome: LLM differential diagnosis accuracy by prompt language (top-1 and top-3 rank)
links.effect: GPT-4o top-1 was 19.9% in English vs 16.9%-20.6% in nine non-English languages; top-3 was 27.0% in English vs 25.4%-28.6% in others. Performance largely consistent across languages.
links.quote: For English, GPT-4o placed the correct diagnosis at the first rank 19.9% and within the top-3 ranks 27.0% of the time.

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM diagnostic performance across multilingual clinical vignettes using automated ontology-based benchmarking, without testing a clinical deployment practice or safeguard.
